note_tweet.text:
Was revisiting this lecture today, proactive agents are something that I'm really interested in. Started really thinking about it ~1.5 years ago, when I was doing growvy (https://t.co/7IM7LFv7l3) and wanted this kind of always-on feeling that @bot, dots and many others are trying to achieve today.

I think we are still not close to get it, how can proactive be a "routine" or a "schedule" which is at high level just a cron job that wakes the agent up, I did like the webhooks that grok bot has, same as I thought for growvy, but thats still not enough. Outside coding, the models are still dumb, forget a lot of things when multi tasking/long tasking. I encountered myself a lot of times with my group of bots having to remember THEM about something they should have known.

Nội dung bài viết:

Hầu hết mọi người vẫn dùng AI sai cách: chỉ hỏi câu hỏi. Elon Musk chỉ ra cách đúng: đối xử với Grok Bot như đồng đội, giao nhiệm vụ tham vọng như cho nhân viên mới. Anh ấy nói “This is the way.”

Ví dụ: Scott Billows dùng Grok đào dữ liệu công ty, tìm khách hàng cũ bị quên, giao cho sales. 2 tuần sau chốt deal. “Không có Grok Bot thì chắc không liên hệ được.”

AI không phải máy trả lời hay chatbot, mà là đồng nghiệp. Hãy coi như đang thuê nhân viên siêu năng lực. Ai cũng có thể có team. Ngừng hỏi, hãy giao việc cho nó.
